{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check how many -999 in biomarker_baseline per arm
crosstab = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999)
print(crosstab)

# Calculate the proportion of -999 in each arm
prop_missing_by_arm = df.groupby('arm')['biomarker_baseline'].apply(lambda x: (x == -999).mean())
print('\nProportion of -999 by arm:')
print(prop_missing_by_arm)"}
